Class AAText

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.views.animatedareadisplay.AAObject
sysmlinjava.views.animatedareadisplay.AAText
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class AAText extends AAObject implements Serializable
Representation of a text object in an area display. Contains the parameters needed to display text in the display at a specified position, font, color, etc.
Author:
ModelerOne
